items.title: MoneyGram CEO on Launch of New Payments Card
items.content: Anthony Soohoo, CEO of MoneyGram, said the company was surprised by the Senate's failure to advance the Clarity Act, but emphasized that MoneyGram will keep moving forward and focus on what it can control. He said it is too early to tell whether the bill, or something like it, will pass soon, and noted that the company is reassessing the regulatory environment. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Authentic Brands’ Matt Maddox: Ready to IPO Early 2027
items.content: Matt Maddox, CEO of Authentic Brands, discusses why the company is partnering with creator Steven Bartlett in a joint venture rather than pursuing a buyout-style deal. Maddox says Authentic Brands sees the creator economy as a major growth engine for media and audience expansion over the next decade, and views Bartlett as a strong partner for building brands through creator-led platforms. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Are We Losing Control of AI? What’s Driving New Fears
items.content: For years, as artificial intelligence has evolved from the stuff of sci-fi movies to an app ordinary people have installed on their phones, tech leaders and some AI insiders have talked about the potential for it to escape human control and wreak havoc on society. Those fears have become impossible to ignore in recent days, driven by advances in the technology, a series of cybersecurity breaches involving AI agents, and new warnings from rank-and-file AI staffers.
